root_cause: The Supabase direct Postgres hostname is IPv6 by default, while the GitHub-hosted runner path used by the trusted migration repair cannot depend on IPv6 reachability. Retrying the direct endpoint therefore preserved the same network-family failure instead of changing transport.
prevention: Use the shared Supavisor session pooler on port 5432 as the canonical GitHub Actions Postgres transport.
Canonicalize the OIDC bridge source in the repository and return an explicit supavisor-session-ipv4 transport marker.
Fail closed unless host, port, username and sslmode exactly match the approved Supavisor session transport.
Reject the direct db.<project>.supabase.co route in CI.
Prove IPv4 A-record reachability before any Supabase CLI migration-history operation.

evaluation.expected: The trusted repair accepts only the canonical Supavisor session-mode IPv4 transport, rejects direct IPv6 routing before mutation, and does not falsely demand a database preview for function-only config metadata.
